title: No opening price exists anywhere in the project
detail: Every price in the corpus is a single snapshot. CLV cannot be signed and no move-based strategy can be evaluated. The desk records G3_CLV as failed-by-construction rather than silently passing it.

title: Houston publishes its depth chart as an image
detail: The page text contains a heading and one image element; no names. A direct fetch of the image from static.clubs.nfl.com is blocked by the sandbox TLS policy, and the permitted text fetcher does not transcribe images. Houston therefore contributes zero depth rows. Guessing would be a fabricated reading of a picture.

title: The corpus holds two price series that disagree
detail: games.spread_line_home and closing.csv differ on 958 of 2,969 joinable games (2006-2018); 17 of those differences sit on opposite sides of zero with a gap of at least half a point, so the two series disagree about which side is favoured; the median absolute difference is 0 points and the 90th percentile is 0.5. The desk uses one series only and says so on every table.

title: No official inactive list can be read
detail: https://www.nfl.com/inactives/league/2026/reg10 returns HTTP 404. Without inactives, a replacement can be inferred but never confirmed.

title: No game book and no snap counts
detail: Neither an official game book (PDF) nor an official snap-count feed has been read. The nflverse release asset host (release-assets.githubusercontent.com) is blocked from the sandbox, so even the public snap-count files cannot be fetched here.

title: The reported Baltimore staleness does not reproduce
detail: The brief says Baltimore still publishes Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley at QB after both went on IR. On the 2026-11-17 read the Baltimore QB room is Jacoby Brissett, Joe Fagnano, Kedon Slovis, and Brissett's arrival is dated 11/06 in the official transactions log. The claim was true of an older capture or a different source; it is not true of today's page.

title: The reported Washington empty slot does not reproduce
detail: The brief says Washington leaves a slot empty. On the 2026-11-17 read no offence or defence row has an empty rank-1 cell; the only empty cells are the normal unused rank-2/3/4 cells.

title: Only one of five parsed clubs dates its own chart
detail: Green Bay prints 'Unofficial, Nov. 10, 2026'. Detroit, Baltimore, Seattle and Washington print no date. Every row therefore carries the capture clock time as the authoritative date, and the club's own date only where it exists.

title: The week-11 injury report is not published yet
detail: https://www.nfl.com/injuries/league/2026/reg11 serves the week-10 report (observed heading 'Injuries - WEEK 10'; the week selector offers weeks 1-10). The Colts-Texans game centre independently prints 'Injury Report is not available at this time.' Consequently the week-11 availability picture is empty, and empty is what is published.

title: Two official reads of the week-10 report show no change
detail: The two clock times are 2026-11-15T23:27Z (e46fb855) and 2026-11-17T00:57Z (this session). For the 12 rows compared, no practice or game designation moved. That is the measured delta: zero. It is published as zero rather than replaced by a level.

title: Four modelling constants are choices, not league values
detail: Half-life 365 days, ridge 2.0 points-squared on ratings, ridge 1.0 on rates, and the prior that a game margin has standard deviation 13.5 points before the probit is fitted. All four are published with their values and none is presented as measured.

title: The 2026 season is not a holdout yet
detail: 163 of 272 games carry a closing line and 149 are final. Nothing in this desk scores 2026: the prospective sample is empty, so the prospective stage of the leaderboard is empty.

title: The 136-game log reconciles into the corpus
detail: The 145 rows of nfl-desk-e46fb855/data/results_feed.csv (the brief calls it a 136-game log; the file holds 145 finals) match the pinned corpus game for game: 145 of 145, exact scores.

title: A rating fitted on 1999 is not comparable with a 2026 rating without care
detail: Franchise codes are normalised (OAK->LV, SD->LAC, STL->LA, WSH/LAR->WAS/LA), but the league itself changed: 31 teams in 1999, 32 from 2002, and the 17-game season from 2021. The corpus keeps every game and the split is by season, so no rating mixes eras within one fit window except through the 365-day half-life decay.

title: The two official price sources cannot be de-vigged against each other
detail: The de-vig uses the two-sided spread prices in the same row. Where a row carries only one side's price, the bet is dropped rather than de-vigged from an assumption. The count of dropped rows is published on the price-store page.

title: No player-level game statistics in the corpus
detail: The pinned repository holds schedules, lines, rosters and closing lines but no per-game player statistics. Player props and same-game parlays therefore cannot be priced at all, and their joint-evidence gate cannot be tested.
